messages:
jess: Heads-up — finalizing the newsletter + nurture drip for the 2026-05-10 benchmarking webinar. Goal: max registrants from product-led signups and keep QA on send quality. Thinking a 4-day micro-wave warmup targeting: trial-users, api-engagers, and early-adopters. Need: subject lines (A/B), precise segment rules, send windows (staggered), UTMs, and post-webinar follow-up cadence. Who owns what? :eyes:

mike: I can take subject lines + preview text. Quick A/B ideas: A) "Benchmark webinar: cut inference cost & latency" B) "Live 5/10 — real numbers on inference performance". Preview A: "See how teams saved 3x token cost" Preview B: "Benchmarks, configs, and tradeoffs"

jess: love it. mike — can you produce 4 subject variants (2 per test) by EOD tomorrow?

eva: Segment rules: prefer deterministic, easy to compute for DB export. Proposals: 
- trial-users: created_at <= 30d && last_active >= last_14d && api_calls_30d >= 1
- api-engagers: api_calls_30d >= 3 || recent-opened-sdk-repo
- early-adopters: opted_in_beta == true || invited_to-alpha == true
Exclude: unsubscribed || bounced || registered_for_webinar
I'll export lists and add suppression for customers on custom pricing.

sam: For send windows, recommend micro-waves to flatten traffic and test open rates:
- Wave 1 (North America): 2026-05-06 09:00 PDT
- Wave 2 (EMEA): 2026-05-06 13:30 BST
- Wave 3 (APAC): 2026-05-07 18:00 JST
Stagger by 24–36h for each segment subset so registration page can handle spikes. Use unique reg links per wave for attribution.

alex: Nurture cadence notes:
- Pre: initial invite, reminder (48h), final reminder (2h before)
- If not-registered after final: 3-step drip over 7 days with subject refresh + social proof
- Post: 0-1 day replay + 3 days post follow-up with top-5 takeaways + trial CTA + code snippet sample
Also recommend separate path for registrants -> add to calendar + webinar reminder SMS if phone exists.

mike: subject variants done. Sending options for preview text too. Putting copy in the doc: https://docs.redwood/example (placeholder)

jess: For UTMs, standardize to: 
utm_campaign=benchmark-webinar-5-10&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_content={wave}-{segment}
Use reg links with token param to map back to source.

sam: Automation config: send via CampaignEngine, throttle 500/s reg hits, retry window 15m. Add 1% holdback (control) for each wave to measure impact.

mike: Quick ask — can product ops supply a short quote or 1-line result (p95 latency, cost delta) for the email hero? That helps CTR.

jess: yep, pinged product for a 1-liner. eva, sam — please share exported segment CSVs by tomorrow morning so QA can run deliverability checks.

marco-bot: Campaign scheduled draft created: "benchmark-webinar-5-10" start=2026-05-06T09:00:00-07:00 owner=jess status=waiting_for_assets

eva: CSVs ready by 10:00 PT. I'll flag any high-bounce addresses and mark enterprise accounts for manual review.

alex: Post-webinar replay content — I'll draft the top-5 takeaways + code sample for trial flow. Plan to include a short checklist for platform tuning (batching, KV caching, quant profiles) as promised in the talk.

jess: Timeline recap:
- today: finalize subject variants + preview (mike)
- tomorrow morning: segment exports & CSVs (eva)
- tomorrow EOD: campaign assets in doc + reg links (mike/sam)
- 2026-05-06 start: wave 1 sends
If that matches, I'll lock the send windows and brief CS on expected inbound. :thumbsup:

sam: matches from my side. I'll add the 1% control and staging sends to the runbook.

mike: copy + 4 subject lines uploaded. tagging jess for review.

jess: awesome — locking this. final note: use the "micro-wave" subject line only for the early-adopters group (higher tolerance). For trials and api-engagers go broader language. Thanks team! :seedling:
